reason: Successfully tested agent messaging flow: navigated to the app, found and opened the QA-20261021-211154-ua6g agent, verified idle status, sent arithmetic question, and received correct response mentioning "4".
steps: Step 1: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Page loaded successfully with title "Gamut" and sidebar showing available agents.
Step 2: Found and clicked on "QA-20261021-211154-ua6g" agent in the sidebar — Successfully clicked on the agent link and navigated to the agent detail page.
Step 3: Verified agent status is "running" or "idle" — Agent status confirmed as "idle" (shown in the top status bar of the agent page).
Step 4: Sent message "Hello! What is 2+2?" — Message typed into the input field and sent successfully via the send button. Message appeared in chat at 9:12 PM. Page navigated to the session URL.

Step 5: Waited up to 3 minutes for response — Agent processed the message and completed within approximately 2 minutes (sidebar shows "Last run 2 minutes ago"). Agent status changed from "working" to "idle".

Step 6: Verified response mentions "4" and took screenshot — Agent responded with "2 + 2 = 4." which clearly contains the number "4". Screenshot taken showing the complete conversation with both the user message and the agent's response.
